name: SmartSurvey
description_en:
SmartSurvey is a hosted questionnaire and feedback platform. It combines question design, respondent-specific logic, distribution and reports, with optional automation and broader customer, employee, patient and citizen-experience programmes. A simple link survey and a multi-team feedback programme can therefore use the same vendor without requiring the same plan or implementation.

Its logic tools distinguish hiding content from moving between pages, reuse earlier answers and carry known contact data into results. Pricing distinguishes monthly subscriptions from annual commitments, and free use from a restricted paid-feature trial. This profile focuses on the survey platform and does not assume every branded experience programme is included.
description_zh:
SmartSurvey 是托管问卷与反馈平台，结合题目设计、按受访者变化的逻辑、分发及报表，另有自动化和客户、员工、患者、公民体验项目。简单链接问卷与跨团队反馈计划可以使用同一厂商，但所需套餐和实施方式不同。

其逻辑工具区分隐藏内容与跨页面跳转，能够复用先前答案，并把已知联系数据带入结果。定价区分月度订阅与年度承诺，也区分持续免费使用与受限制的付费功能试用。本文重点是问卷平台，不假设每个品牌体验项目都已包含。

core_features.explanation_zh: 付费版本增加原始数据导出；Basic 仅列 Word 结果摘要。

steps.en: Pass only necessary custom context and test both an anonymous and a known-contact path.
steps.zh: 只传入必要上下文，分别测试匿名与已知联系人的路径。

items.en: The fourteen-day trial permits viewing 100 responses and exporting only ten; contact lists are limited to ten participants.
items.zh: 14 天试用只允许查看 100 条、导出 10 条回答，每份联系名单限 10 位参与者。

items.en: Annual cancellation or downgrade takes effect at the end of the committed term, without partial-period refunds.
items.zh: 年度取消或降级在承诺期结束后生效，不退还部分账期费用。

pricing.billing_basis: GBP subscriptions excluding VAT; annual and monthly response/email capacities differ, Growth priced per user.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Basic is free with one user and 100 responses/month. Advanced shows £90 monthly, or £70/month billed £840 annually; the annual allowance is 30,000 responses and 90,000 email invites, versus monthly-view allowances of 2,000 and 6,000. Growth shows £125/user monthly or £100/user/month billed £1,200 annually. Scale and programme solutions require an enquiry. All paid prices exclude VAT.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Basic 免费，1 人、每月 100 条回答。Advanced 月付 £90，或年付 £840、折合每月 £70；年度额度为 30,000 条回答及 90,000 次邮件邀请，而月付视图额度为 2,000 条及 6,000 次。Growth 月付每人 £125，或年付每人 £1,200、折合每月 £100。Scale 和体验项目需询价。所有付费价格未含 VAT。

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Use the right kind of conditional path
sections.en:
Display logic hides or reveals questions, pages and answer choices; skip logic sends a respondent to a different page. Piping inserts an earlier answer into later wording. Custom variables pass known context through a survey URL or contact list without asking another question.

For a product-feedback example, a non-user can skip the usage section while an active user sees a relevant follow-up. Check blank context values and changes to earlier answers rather than testing only the ideal path. Defaults can speed entry but should not be mistaken for a respondent’s deliberate choice.
sections.zh:
显示逻辑决定问题、页面和选项是否出现，跳题逻辑则把回答者送往另一页面；piping 把先前答案插入后续文字，自定义变量通过问卷 URL 或联系名单传入已知上下文，无需另问一题。

例如产品反馈中，未使用过产品的人跳过使用部分，活跃用户进入相关追问。应检查上下文为空及修改先前答案等情况，不只测试理想路径。默认答案可以加快输入，但不能误当作回答者主动选择。

sections.title_en: Decide how a response becomes usable evidence
sections.title_zh: 先决定回答如何变成可用资料
sections.en:
The platform offers link, email, embed and other collection routes, with reports and exports varying by plan. Basic lists a Word summary export; Advanced adds XLS, CSV, PDF and Word exports. Growth adds multi-user permissions, shared surveys and API/webhooks, while Scale lists conditional email triggers and broader analysis.

Before collecting operational data, confirm the exact export fields and permissions needed by the analyst. A visually complete report is not proof that the raw data or respondent context is available to downstream systems. No export or integration was executed here.
sections.zh:
平台提供链接、邮件、嵌入等收集方式，报表和导出随套餐变化。Basic 列 Word 摘要导出，Advanced 增加 XLS、CSV、PDF 和 Word；Growth 增加多用户权限、共享问卷及 API/webhooks，Scale 列有条件邮件触发和更广分析。

正式收集前，先确认分析员需要的具体导出字段与权限。报表视觉完整，不代表下游系统可获得原始数据或回答者上下文。本文未执行导出或集成。

sections.title_en: Do not interchange annual and monthly allowances
sections.title_zh: 不要混用年付与月付额度
sections.en:
Advanced advertises £90 on monthly billing or £840 charged annually, equivalent to £70 per month before VAT. Annual billing lists 30,000 responses and 90,000 invitations per year, while the monthly view lists 2,000 and 6,000. The yearly allowance is therefore not simply twelve identical monthly bundles. Growth is priced per user, with a £1,200 annual charge per user or £125 monthly.

Scale and specialised SmartCX, SmartEX, SmartPX and SmartCE programmes use a tailored discussion. Identify the needed users, sends, response period and add-ons before comparing the headline amount. SMS access is not evidence that message credits are included.
sections.zh:
Advanced 月付 £90，或年付 £840、折合每月 £70，均未含 VAT。年付列每年 30,000 条回答、90,000 次邀请，月付视图则列 2,000 条和 6,000 次，因此年度容量不是十二份相同月度包。Growth 按人计费，每人年付 £1,200，或月付 £125。

Scale 及 SmartCX、SmartEX、SmartPX、SmartCE 专业项目采用定制洽谈。比较标题金额前需明确人数、发送量、回答周期与附加项。允许使用短信不证明短信额度已包含。

sections.title_en: Use trial data limits and cancellation rules in the plan
sections.title_zh: 把试用数据限制与取消规则纳入计划
sections.en:
The Basic plan is ongoing free use with 100 responses per month. Paid-feature trials last fourteen days, limit a contact list to ten participants, allow viewing 100 responses and exporting ten. Responses beyond the viewing limit are described as becoming visible after upgrading, so the trial is not a free production deployment.

Annual plans remain committed for the full term; cancellation or downgrade applies at period end and partial-term refunds or credits are not offered. Monthly changes also apply at period end. Invoice customers must give 31 days’ notice. These conditions matter more than a general cancel-anytime headline.
sections.zh:
Basic 为持续免费，每月 100 条回答。付费功能试用持续 14 天，每份名单限 10 人，可查看 100 条、导出 10 条。超出查看上限的回答需升级后才可见，因此试用不能当作免费生产部署。

年度套餐需履行完整承诺期，取消或降级到期生效，不提供部分账期退款或抵扣；月度变更也在当期结束后生效。发票付费客户需提前 31 天通知。这些条件比笼统的“随时取消”更影响选择。

sections.title_en: Check hosting and programme scope before committing
sections.title_zh: 确认托管与项目范围后再购买
sections.en:
The vendor says data is stored and backed up on UK/EU servers. That public description is not a substitute for a workload-specific DPA, exact location or retention agreement. The product is presented as a hosted service; no self-hosted server package or open-source license was verified.

SmartSurvey deserves evaluation for conditional questionnaires and shared feedback programmes where export and governance matter. A minimal poll may fit Basic, whereas sensitive programmes, advanced analysis, SSO and custom contractual terms need the relevant plan discussion. Vendor security and outcome statements were not independently audited.
sections.zh:
厂商称数据存储并备份在英国/欧盟服务器，但这一公开说明不能替代具体工作负载的 DPA、准确位置或保留约定。产品作为托管服务呈现，本次未确认自托管服务包或开源许可。

需要条件问卷、共享反馈项目并重视导出和管理时，可以评估 SmartSurvey。简易投票可能适合 Basic；敏感项目、高级分析、SSO 和定制合同应结合对应套餐洽谈。本文未独立审计安全或效果主张。

research_gaps: No survey execution, email delivery, variable mapping, raw-data export, API or offline workflow was tested.
Exact SMS credits, quota exhaustion, yearly allocation across users and add-on charges require confirmation.
DPA-specific data location/retention, source license, self-hosting and administrator interface languages remain unverified.
